**Parse the pack manifest after npm 10 prepare output.**

`npm pack --ignore-scripts --json` can write `prepare` output before the JSON array. Parse the JSON from the last newline before `[` so the release does not fail at the pack step.

<details>
<summary>🐛 Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
--- "a/.github/workflows/release.yml"
+++ "b/.github/workflows/release.yml"
@@ -205,8 +205,8 @@
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           mkdir release-artifact
           npm pack --ignore-scripts --json > pack.json
-          filename="$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('pack.json','utf8'))[0].filename")"
+          filename="$(node -p "const s=require('node:fs').readFileSync('pack.json','utf8');JSON.parse(s.slice(s.lastIndexOf('\n[')+1))[0].filename")"
           mv "$filename" release-artifact/package.tgz
           cp RELEASE_NOTES.md release-artifact/RELEASE_NOTES.md
           git branch verified-release HEAD
```

</details>
